name: pulse-behavior-testing
description: Writes and maintains behaviour-driven React component tests in this Laravel app using Jest, React Testing Library, user-event, and jest-dom. Use for user interactions, keyboard accessibility, focus, async states, callbacks, validation, public API contracts, and regression tests.
purpose: Implement tests that protect visible behaviour, accessibility, and public API contracts while allowing internals to change.
single_responsibility: Authoring behaviour-driven Jest + React Testing Library tests for visible behaviour, accessibility, and public API contracts.
triggers: A test plan or behaviour scenarios exist to implement
Accessibility or keyboard behaviour must be verified in tests
outputs: Test command results or skipped-test explanation
completion_criteria: Tests use `screen` and accessible queries such as `getByRole` and `getByLabelText`
Visible behaviour and public callbacks are asserted with `jest-dom` matchers
The narrowest relevant test command has been run or a tooling gap is reported
failure_handling: If React test tooling is not configured, stop and report the gap instead of adding it unrequested.
Report any scenario that cannot be tested through accessible, user-observable behaviour.
escalation_path: Route uncertain Jest, React Testing Library, `user-event`, or `jest-dom` APIs through jest-react-testing or pulse-docs-research.
Escalate to the user when test tooling must be added or a behaviour scenario is ambiguous.
Return missing or unclear scenarios to pulse-tdd-planning.
responsibilities: Write Jest and React Testing Library tests.
Use `jest-react-testing` and Context7 Testing Library docs when test setup, async queries, or interaction APIs are uncertain.
non_responsibilities: Testing Tailwind classes, private state, Motion configuration, or Radix internals.
